testcase.name: a protein missing from the gene rules is tested as a reaction, never as a gene knockout
a gene label on the model is no substitute for an EC to reaction mapping
weak claims that the integration did not retain still get a hypothesis
the shortlist follows measured evidence and uncertainty, not protein names
transport and BGC evidence comes only from exact model exchange ids; anything else is listed as unmapped
a reaction-graph id counts only when it is a reaction id of the model
intracellular product hints require exact declared targets and never imply secretion
a medium that merely grows the wild type less is not a deletion effect: a whole-gene knockout is no feature
an unchanged gene knockout is not optional flux
flux class and deletion effect come from the per-reaction checks of the same condition
a gene with several reactions: the deletion effect cannot be attributed to one reaction
on timeout the sidecar and its children are killed and nothing writes late
an earlier output that cannot be removed stops the run instead of passing for it
